Class Server

java.lang.Object
java.rmi.server.RemoteObject
java.rmi.server.RemoteServer
java.rmi.server.UnicastRemoteObject
mesos.am30.server.Server
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable, Remote, IF_Server
public class Server extends UnicastRemoteObject implements IF_Server
Static Server for the game "Mesos".
This class works as a static implementation of the Server for the game "Mesos".
It handles new Clients connecting both via Socket and RMI, binding them to the Controller for the specific lobby.
This class extends the class UnicastRemoteObject and implements the interface Remote, in order to work both via RMI and Socket.

    • getInstance

      public static Server getInstance() throws RemoteException
      Static Getter for the Server.
      This static method returns the static instance of the Server.
      This allows everything to work in the intended way, even if more instances of the program run simultaneously.
      Returns:
      Static instance of the Server.
      Throws:
      RemoteException - The Server cannot be instantiated correctly.

    • main

      public static void main(String[] args) throws IOException
      Main entry point for the "Mesos" Server.
      This method is the main entry point for the "Mesos" Server; it creates (or connects to) the Server instance, then opens both the RMI and Socket channel of communications as Threads.
      Throws:
      IOException - The connection cannot be established correctly.

    • setNickname

      public void setNickname(IF_GameView view, String nickname, String code) throws IOException
      Description copied from interface: IF_Server
      Check the nickname of a Client.
      This method is invocated from each Client connecting to the lobby, and works as the Server-side counterpart to the method view.askNickname().
      If the nickname is valid (no duplicates), the Server connects the Client to the lobby.
      Pre: view != null && nickname != null && code != null
      Post: !\old(lobby.getClients().keySet().contains(nickname)) ==> lobby.getClients().keySet().contains(nickname)
      Specified by:
      setNickname in interface IF_Server
      Parameters:
      view - The Client instance of the IF_GameView.
      nickname - Nickname of the Client.
      Throws:
      IOException - The connection cannot be established correctly.
      See Also:
